notes.title: Patchnote 20200418
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your support to Blind Spot. We have fixed some identified issues in our latest patch:

[list]
[*]Fixed a missing scenery in ballroom.
[*]Fixed able to save repeatedly in the last room of chapter 3.
[*]Fixed item sometimes appear at incorrect position in theater.
[*]Fixed some collision issue.
[*]Fixed some incorrect materials.
[/list]

Also, don't forget you can set walking speed and head bobbing amount in options.

As always, we welcome your feedback.
